Viraj R. Rajput 

 +91 9891325484 | virajrajput299@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/virajtherajput  

 EDUCATION 

Master of Science, Computer Engineering 	 	                                                    	 	           	       May 2019 California State University, Fullerton  

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSES 

Juniper JUNOS Customized course

IP/MPLS Services Provisioning, SR-OS by Alcatel-Lucent University

Pursuing CCIE Devnet

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Routing & Switching: OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, STP, Layer 3 Switching, IPv6

Network Security: Cisco NGFW, Palo Alto, Fortinet, VPN, Cisco ISE, Web Security Appliance (WSA), AAA

Network Automation and scripting: Python (Netmiko, NAPALM), Ansible, REST APIs (Cisco, Fortinet), YAML, JSON

Monitoring & Telemetry: SNMPv3, NetFlow, Syslog, Wireshark, SIEM Integration

Cloud & SDN: Azure Networking (VNet, NSG, route tables), Cisco SD-WAN (Viptela-based), VMware NSX, VXLAN

Protocols & Services: DHCP, DNS, NTP

Tools & Platforms: Cisco IOS/NX-OS, Juniper JUNOS, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Arista EOS, VMware vSphere

RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE 

   Network Consulting Engineer –   McKinsey & Company 				                   June 2025 – Present 

   Responsibilities: 

Supported network assessment and improvement projects for banking clients under McKinsey’s guidance

Assisted in analysing existing IT infrastructure and identifying performance or security issues

Helped implement network solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements (Universal App, UPI)

Coordinated with McKinsey consultants and client IT teams to gather data and prepare technical documentation

Contributed to project delivery by supporting testing, troubleshooting, and deployment activities

Technical Consulting Engineer – Cisco Systems, Inc.                                                                    September 2019 – April 2024                                           Responsibilities: 

Delivered technical consulting for Cisco security products to customers, partners, account teams, and internal support teams

Resolved a wide range of issues, from basic configurations to high complexity troubleshooting and root cause analysis

Filed accurate defect reports in collaboration with engineering teams

Operated independently, applying sound judgment within established processes

Coordinated with TAC engineers across technologies to resolve multi-domain issues

 Accomplishments: 

Resolved moderate to high-complexity product and network issues using strong analytical and technical skills

Acted as primary escalation point for large enterprise accounts

Recreated and resolved complex issues in lab environments using real-world simulations

Overview: 

Strong foundation in routing, switching, and firewall technologies. Proficient in resolving complex network issues in hybrid and multi-cloud environments using structured troubleshooting approaches and industry tools. Experienced across the full network lifecycle: design, deployment, configuration, support, and debugging

      Significant troubleshooting: 

Performed deep testing and analysis of next-generation firewalls (NGFW), resolving advanced security and application-layer     issues beyond traditional firewall capabilities

      IP Subject Matter Expert - Vodafone India Pvt. Ltd.                                                                       August 2015 – December 2016                

      Responsibilities: 

Managed fault resolution, root cause analysis, and vendor coordination for Vodafone’s national IP/MPLS backbone

Led planning and execution of hardware/software upgrades, disaster recovery, and network performance improvements

Implemented SOPs, network monitoring tools, and optimization strategies to enhance reliability and SLA adherence

Oversaw capacity planning, infrastructure scaling, and IT network projects including QoS, routing topology, and system security

     Accomplishments: 

Acted as the single point of contact for all fault management, provisioning, deployments, and planned activities across Vodafone’s national IP/MPLS backbone—supporting 60+ 100G super-core routers, 6 international gateways, 30+ voice nodes, 3500+ regional network elements, and 150,000+ mobility/captive endpoints

Delivered scalable, cost-effective transport solutions for captive mobility (3G/4G), enterprise, and internal IT services by improving processes and driving IP transport architecture across NPLC, IPLC, ILL, VPN, and PRI circuits

Overview: 

Managed high-availability IP/MPLS networks supporting mobility, voice, and triple-play services across India. Architected and maintained complex topologies—hub-spoke, partial mesh, full mesh—using protocols like MP-BGP, IS-IS (AS 65XXX, 55410, 1273), OSPF (for backdoor paths), and MPLS technologies (LDP, RSVP-TE). Deployed services including L2VPN, L3VPN, multicast, VPLS, and IPsec VPN. Built scalable routing hierarchies using regional and national RRs and enabled inter-AS communication with Type-A/Type-B NNIs. Worked across OSS, BSS, and transmission layers to ensure robust end-to-end service delivery

Significant troubleshooting: 

Resolved issues such as traffic dips, web server global reachability, inter-AS routing challenges, and policy inconsistencies using a structured, multi-layered approach. Redesigned routing policies and proactively addressed backbone performance and stability concerns

Associate Engineer -Tata Communications Pvt. Ltd.                                                                                   April 2014 – August 2015    Responsibilities: 

Provided technical guidance to cross-functional teams including Automation, Pre-Sales/Solution Architects, Monitoring, Service Delivery, and Managed Services

Handled global customer network issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and Internet segments, ensuring continuous service delivery for VPN clients across 600+ global PoPs

Re-engineered routing policies to ensure link redundancy, high availability, and fault tolerance across critical network paths

     Accomplishments: 

Validated and optimized complex, multi-vendor, multi-protocol MPLS VPN topologies by devising workarounds for deployment and operational challenges

Developed low-level VPN solution designs, ensuring seamless provisioning and maintenance across a globally distributed client base (600+ IP/WAN PoPs, 1600+ service provider demarcations)

Led business continuity planning (BCP) drills involving multi-homing/single-homing scenarios, and various topologies including hub-spoke, full mesh, site-to-site, and DR failovers—improving resilience through routing policy redesign

Overview: 

Worked within the India demarcation zone (AS 4755) to manage route aggregation and injection across client and ISP boundaries. Employed OSPF as IGP and MPLS LDP for label distribution; used Type-B NNI for intra-AS communication between AS 4755 and AS 6453. Supported topologies included hub-spoke, full mesh, and partial mesh. Routing protocols used for WAN included Static, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, and RIP

Significant troubleshooting: 

Resolved issues related to IP reachability, routing inconsistencies, and integration with monitoring systems. Conducted BCP drills and redefined routing strategies to support high availability and business continuity

ACHIEVEMENTS 

Awarded Employee of the Year for disaster recovery and link migration at Vodafone Chennai NDC

Presented MANET routing protocol analysis at IEEE conference as team lead

Delivered 7750 SR migration training to Vodafone and Wipro network teams

Conducted embedded systems workshops as active ETESA member

Speaker at Cisco Live 2022 on Secure Firewall Upgrade best practices

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Technical Consulting Engineer – Cisco Systems, Inc.                                                                    September 2019 – April 2024                                           Responsibilities: 
Delivered technical consulting for Cisco security products to customers, partners, account teams, and internal support teams
Resolved a wide range of issues, from basic configurations to high complexity troubleshooting and root cause analysis
Filed accurate defect reports in collaboration with engineering teams
Operated independently, applying sound judgment within established processes
Coordinated with TAC engineers across technologies to resolve multi-domain issues
 Accomplishments: 
Resolved moderate to high-complexity product and network issues using strong analytical and technical skills
Acted as primary escalation point for large enterprise accounts
Recreated and resolved complex issues in lab environments using real-world simulations
Overview: 
Strong foundation in routing, switching, and firewall technologies. Proficient in resolving complex network issues in hybrid and multi-cloud environments using structured troubleshooting approaches and industry tools. Experienced across the full network lifecycle: design, deployment, configuration, support, and debugging
      Significant troubleshooting: 
Performed deep testing and analysis of next-generation firewalls (NGFW), resolving advanced security and application-layer     issues beyond traditional firewall capabilities
      IP Subject Matter Expert - Vodafone India Pvt. Ltd.                                                                       August 2015 – December 2016                
      Responsibilities: 
Managed fault resolution, root cause analysis, and vendor coordination for Vodafone’s national IP/MPLS backbone
Led planning and execution of hardware/software upgrades, disaster recovery, and network performance improvements
Implemented SOPs, network monitoring tools, and optimization strategies to enhance reliability and SLA adherence
Oversaw capacity planning, infrastructure scaling, and IT network projects including QoS, routing topology, and system security
     Accomplishments: 
Acted as the single point of contact for all fault management, provisioning, deployments, and planned activities across Vodafone’s national IP/MPLS backbone—supporting 60+ 100G super-core routers, 6 international gateways, 30+ voice nodes, 3500+ regional network elements, and 150,000+ mobility/captive endpoints
Delivered scalable, cost-effective transport solutions for captive mobility (3G/4G), enterprise, and internal IT services by improving processes and driving IP transport architecture across NPLC, IPLC, ILL, VPN, and PRI circuits
Overview: 
Managed high-availability IP/MPLS networks supporting mobility, voice, and triple-play services across India. Architected and maintained complex topologies—hub-spoke, partial mesh, full mesh—using protocols like MP-BGP, IS-IS (AS 65XXX, 55410, 1273), OSPF (for backdoor paths), and MPLS technologies (LDP, RSVP-TE). Deployed services including L2VPN, L3VPN, multicast, VPLS, and IPsec VPN. Built scalable routing hierarchies using regional and national RRs and enabled inter-AS communication with Type-A/Type-B NNIs. Worked across OSS, BSS, and transmission layers to ensure robust end-to-end service delivery
Significant troubleshooting: 
Resolved issues such as traffic dips, web server global reachability, inter-AS routing challenges, and policy inconsistencies using a structured, multi-layered approach. Redesigned routing policies and proactively addressed backbone performance and stability concerns
Associate Engineer -Tata Communications Pvt. Ltd.                                                                                   April 2014 – August 2015    Responsibilities: 
Provided technical guidance to cross-functional teams including Automation, Pre-Sales/Solution Architects, Monitoring, Service Delivery, and Managed Services
Handled global customer network issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and Internet segments, ensuring continuous service delivery for VPN clients across 600+ global PoPs
Re-engineered routing policies to ensure link redundancy, high availability, and fault tolerance across critical network paths
     Accomplishments: 
Validated and optimized complex, multi-vendor, multi-protocol MPLS VPN topologies by devising workarounds for deployment and operational challenges
Developed low-level VPN solution designs, ensuring seamless provisioning and maintenance across a globally distributed client base (600+ IP/WAN PoPs, 1600+ service provider demarcations)
Led business continuity planning (BCP) drills involving multi-homing/single-homing scenarios, and various topologies including hub-spoke, full mesh, site-to-site, and DR failovers—improving resilience through routing policy redesign
Overview: 
Worked within the India demarcation zone (AS 4755) to manage route aggregation and injection across client and ISP boundaries. Employed OSPF as IGP and MPLS LDP for label distribution; used Type-B NNI for intra-AS communication between AS 4755 and AS 6453. Supported topologies included hub-spoke, full mesh, and partial mesh. Routing protocols used for WAN included Static, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, and RIP
Significant troubleshooting: 
Resolved issues related to IP reachability, routing inconsistencies, and integration with monitoring systems. Conducted BCP drills and redefined routing strategies to support high availability and business continuity
